payout_quote: Beginning September 1, 2026, when your friend joins Maps, we will give you $50 for each friend you refer — up to $500! Refer up to 10 new members for a total of $500 in Reward Bonuses.
steps: Be a Maps Credit Union member 18+ with a Member Rewards account in good standing
Give your friend the Refer a Friend flyer (social post or email also accepted)
Friend joins Maps and opens a checking account, presenting the referral at account opening (branch-only offer)
You receive $50 per referral, deposited into your Member Rewards account by end of the month following the month of opening
catches: Cap: refer up to 10 new members, $500 total in Reward Bonuses
Friend must open a checking account (minimum deposit $25) and present the referral at account opening
Branch-only offer; cannot be combined with other monetary incentive offers
Your friend gets up to $75 in their own bonuses (membership fee waived + $25 checking bonus + $50 for 10 debit transactions in 30 days)
Member must be 18+ with Member Rewards account in good standing
biggest_catch: $50 per referral with a $500 cap — but it ends October 31, 2026, and it's in-branch only, so you'll need to be near a Maps branch in Oregon.
eligibility: Maps Credit Union members 18+ with Member Rewards account; referred friends must be new members 18+ eligible for membership
timing: Promotion 9/1/2026-10/31/2026; bonus deposited by end of the month after the month of account opening
